# I/O parser fixtures

These unmodified binary fixtures are copied from IREE 3.14.0, revision
`5f72e26ac2e941ccf40ead9e30c438993282de9d`, under
`runtime/src/iree/io/formats/{gguf,irpa,safetensors}/testdata`.

They allow the packaged runtime tests to run without an IREE source checkout.
Their upstream Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception terms are preserved in `LICENSE`
in this directory.
